name: Report to indicator list
description: Convert a Build report result into the flat, typed indicator list Sekoia's add_ioc_to_ioc_collection expects — from malicious samples only by default, child samples included.

report.description: A Build report result ({samples, errors}), given inline.
report.title: Report

report_path.description: Path (on data_path) to a Build report result saved as JSON.
report_path.title: Report Path

verdicts.description: Only samples whose sample_verdict is one of these contribute indicators — child samples are judged on their own verdict. Empty = every sample.
verdicts.title: Verdicts

include_child_samples.description: Also take IOCs from child samples, and add each child sample's own SHA256.
include_child_samples.title: Include Child Samples

Indicator.description: One entry matching add_ioc_to_ioc_collection's expected shape.
Indicator.title: Indicator
